why_agent_cannot: complete identity verification (KYC), solve a CAPTCHA / bot check
what_human_must_do: Pass KYC in your own name (legal step, agent cannot). Then finish the steps in apply/.
steps_from_source: Download the app for iOS or Android from dexari.com .
Create an account with an email code or a Google or Apple login, then set up a passkey. Dexari says this takes no KYC or personal data.
Fund the wallet. You can receive crypto from another wallet, or buy it through MoonPay, which may ask you to complete its own KYC.
Add USDC to your trading account and trade spot or perps in the app. Warning With up to 40x leverage, a small move against you can liquidate a position.
Check your points in the Profile section. Distributions arrive on Wednesdays.
